verdict.rationale: The pack shows Stripe exposes a public API, an official CLI, and an MCP server for agent access, and the llms.txt note implies npm-published SDK packages, but there is no explicit documentation of official language SDKs (Node/Python/Ruby/etc.) or SDK-specific guides in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit SDK reference docs/links, language coverage list, and any independent corroboration of SDK quality or agent usage with them.
